story_text: As a user, I want task creation to fail when an invalid category is provided so that data stays consistent.

positive.title: Create task with a completely invalid category string
steps: 1. Attempt to create a task with category set to 'InvalidCategory'
2. Observe the response from the API
positive.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message lists valid category options

positive.title: Create task with each valid category value
steps: 1. Attempt to create a task with each valid category value
2. Observe the response from the API

negative.title: Create task with numeric category
steps: 1. Attempt to create a task with category set to 123
2. Observe the response from the API
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states category must be a string

negative.title: Update existing task to an invalid category
steps: 1. Create a task with a valid category
2. Attempt to update the task's category to an invalid value
3. Observe the response from the API
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states category must be a string

edge.title: Create task with category containing injection payload
steps: 1. Attempt to create a task with a category containing injection payload
2. Observe the response from the API
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states category must be a string
